title: Relocation
body:
此插件完全支持简体中文,其他语言玩家只需看懂下面内容即可愉快游玩

This is a simple building relocation plugin, with particle effects and sound effects included.
Preview:

![Buildings waiting to be moved and showing preview locations](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66e20873d79a6013e9307002d80fbce9c9b98cf0.png)
![Relocated building (including foundation)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67ee26bc23404d5311a3815a848a33c101ad5a99.png)
![Building waiting to be relocated after a 90-degree rotation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e6111f916299b29e0c2d2389215ca95fcf63144c.png)
![Building relocated after being rotated 90 degrees](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e42f1f6424bfbbebd6a9244203e202531c3b8e8.png)

By default, the plugin can be used by all players. You can change it to false in the configuration file to allow only administrators and whitelisted players to use it.

Player command:

/r help

Show help information

/r selection

Enter selection mode to use the hoe's left and right buttons to choose the two points of the building to be moved

/r destination

Use the hoe left-click to select the point where the building will be moved
Right-click with the hoe to rotate the angle

/r execute

Enter to confirm information migration (needs to be entered twice)

/r cancel

Cancel all modes

Administrator Command:

/r add <Player>
  
Add player to whitelist (available when the configuration file blocks everyone from use)

/r remove <Player>
  
Remove player from the whitelist (available when the configuration file is set to disable use for everyone)

/r list

View whitelist list

/r reload

Reload plugin

Attention:

Relocating pure block buildings is the best.

Please turn off all switches before moving the redstone machine

Entities cannot be moved, and rotating migrated buildings may cause some connected blocks to malfunction and require manual placement.

The containers and signboard content cannot be relocated; they will be destroyed.

If you cannot fully trust the server, it is recommended that other players disable all publicly available configurations. Incorrect use can lead to irreversible consequences.

Any suggestions or feedback are welcome, you can contact me at xzm5749@163.com
